entry.title: FET Compressor 1.4.1
entry.summary: Classic FET-style peak compressor with an analog VU meter, 4/8/12/20:1 and all-buttons mode, colour, parallel mix, sidechain HPF and a variety of presets for vocals, drums, bass, guitar, keys and synths. ## Requirements - A first-generation MPC OS standalone device (32-bit ARM, like the Force, MPC Live / Live II, One, X and Key 61). The installer refuses anything else. Newer models are untested. - **Root shell access** (SSH) to the device, for the scripted install below. Stock MPC OS doesn't off
